import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    ev = 0
    od = 0
    pq = []
    import heapq
    for i in range(n):
        if i != 0 and ev == od:
            heapq.heappush(pq, abs(a[i] - a[i-1]))
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            ev += 1
        else:
            od += 1
    cnt = 0
    while pq:
        g = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if g <= k:
            cnt += 1
            k -= g
        else:
            break
    print(cnt)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
